page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highcpu-4 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on an arm64 architecture, the c4a-highcpu-4 offers a resource-dense profile designed for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as web serving, containerized microservices, distributed application nodes, and lightweight continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
